jobs.description:
Role Overview

As a Senior Software Engineer specializing in C++ within Epiroc's Agentic AI division, you will play a pivotal role in developing high-performance software solutions that power cutting-edge mining and construction equipment.

What You Will Do

You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and validating embedded control software that directly impacts the reliability, safety, and efficiency of machinery deployed in challenging real-world environments.

Why It Might Be a Fit

This position offers a unique opportunity to drive innovation by integrating agentic AI methodologies into our software development lifecycle, shaping the future of automated engineering processes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • 5-8 years of professional experience in application software development for embedded systems using C++, with strong Object-Oriented Programming skills.
  • Hands-on understanding of automotive and industrial communication protocols, including CAN, J1939, LIN, and Ethernet.
  • Proven experience working with AI coding assistants and agentic AI workflows, including knowledge of concepts like multi-channel processing (MCP), agent-to-agent (A2A) communication, and agent skills design.
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and project management tools like JIRA and Polarion.
  • Demonstrated ability in designing and operating agentic systems in complex engineering environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with effective written and verbal communication skills to collaborate across diverse teams.
  • Experience working within Agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.
jobs.requirements_summary: The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, experience with AI coding assistants, and a proven ability to design and operate agentic systems in complex engineering environments

company_data.description_summary: Epiroc is a leading provider of mining and infrastructure equipment, offering advanced technology and expert services to maximize productivity and sustainability. With a focus on safety, environmental responsibility, and customer collaboration, Epiroc delivers reliable solutions for rock excavation, automation, and engineering in the natural resources sector.
